## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status should preserve the revision identifier used by history; its shorter identifier breaks the documented behavior.

## Changes
The pull request adds running deployment output with a shortened revision and attempt number, plus tests for attempt formatting.

(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the history revision width in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, status displays `0123456` while history displays `0123456789ab`. The status docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but the new slice uses seven characters instead of twelve. — Users correlating running deployments with history receive inconsistent identifiers, reducing precision when distinguishing revisions. — Fix: Use `revision[:12]` and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to verify the revision.
